description: This file defines a PHP class 'smpl_Invoice_Sample' that generates a PDF invoice template for the SuiteCRM AOS module. It includes methods to build the invoice body, header, and footer, utilizing external services and translation functions.

classes.name: smpl_Invoice_Sample
classes.description: A class that provides functionalities to generate a PDF invoice template with methods getType, getBody, getHeader, and getFooter.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of document, in this case 'AOS_Invoices'.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Constructs and returns the HTML content for the invoice PDF, including company info, billing details, product and service lists, and totals.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns an empty string, indicating no header content.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Generates and returns the footer HTML for the PDF, including page number and date.
